# Spinzo - Premium Laundry & Dry Cleaning Service in Bangalore

> Spinzo is a fast, premium, tech-enabled laundry and dry cleaning delivery service operating exclusively in South Bangalore, India. 30-minute doorstep pickup and delivery within hours.
>
> **Brand Entity Note:** Spinzo (official domains: https://spinzonow.com and https://spinzo.in) is an independent Bengaluru laundry brand founded by Nischay Kumar. It is NOT affiliated with spynzo.com or Spinz Laundry.

## Core Services & Rates (2026)
- **Wash & Fold**: ₹85/kg. Daily wear washed, dried, and neatly folded. 6–12 hour turnaround. Free doorstep pickup & delivery.
- **Wash & Iron**: ₹140/kg. Professional washing + steam ironing. 24–48 hour turnaround.
- **Steam Ironing / Pressing**: ₹18/piece. Professional steam pressing. Min 5 pieces, free pickup on 20+ pieces.
- **Dry Cleaning**: Starting from ₹79/piece (Blazers ₹149, 2-piece suits ₹249, silk sarees ₹199). Specialized chemical-free solvent care for formals, ethnic wear, and woolens.
- **Blanket Wash**: ₹299 (single) / ₹399 (double). Deep sanitization for blankets, quilts, and comforters.
- **Shoe Cleaning**: From ₹199/pair. Sneakers, canvas, leather, and suede revival.

## Key Features & Guarantees
- 30-minute doorstep pickup guarantee across South Bangalore
- Rapid delivery within 6 hours for Wash & Fold
- Free pickup and delivery on all orders in service areas
- 100% digital weighing scale transparency at your doorstep
- 100% safety guarantee — compensation up to 2x service value in case of damage
- Hygienic individual processing — zero batch-mixing of different customer garments
- Operating hours: 9 AM to 10 PM, 7 days a week
- Customer Support Phone: +91 76768 78832
